race.description: Astute Insurance/Astute Finance Barron River Hcp (Bm60)
race.comment: FOOLS PLAY (6) failed to run a strong 1450m last start after a close third over 1400m at Townsville the run prior. Looks better placed over this shorter trip so rates among the leading chances. TALONS (4) performed above expectations last time over 1609m at Townsville, finishing 1.3 lengths from the winner in fourth after starting at huge odds. Settles back early but winds up late. Will prove tough to stop. PREMIUM STAR (7) drew wide and was pretty plain last time out when 6 lengths from the winner in eighth at this course and distance. Solid top-three hope with the 2kg claim. THE IMPECKABLE (2) is drawn to get all the favours from the inside marble and looks a must for the multiples.
